column1:
The individual business units ensure
that they act in accordance with
mandates, policies and procedures.
They also:
• Identify key risks to own business
• Specify and implement
appropriate risk management
processes
• Specify and implement early
warning measures, as well
as associated reporting and
management processes
• Implement corrective actions, as
required
column2:
Independent oversight and
monitoring risk across business units
Committees (ALCO, Credit Risk
Review, CRMC, NPAG&R, etc)
• Take ownership of and maintain
risk governance and frameworks
• Recommend risk appetite in line
with the strategy
• Review and update risk policies
• Overseeing and monitoring
the implementation of Risk
Management policies
• Ensuring that risk issues are
resolved effectively by risk
owners
Risk Division
• Monitor compliance to risk
appetite and risk policies
• Challenge risk profile through
review of risk assessment,
evaluation of risk management
processes and monitoring of
corrective actions
column3:
Provide independent
assurance of the adequacy and
effectiveness of implementing
policy and procedure
• Evaluation of the
development and
implementation of policies
of relevant business
• Review of the integrity,
accuracy and completeness
of risk reports and other
business reports
